[984](#984)
[985](#985)impl Widget for SignalPanel<'_> {
[986](#986)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[987](#987)        if is_empty(area) {
[988](#988)            return;
[989](#989)        }
[990](#990)
[991](#991)        let block = Block::new(self.title.as_ref())
[992](#992)            .with_borders(BorderStyle::Plain)
[993](#993)            .with_border_color(self.palette.mid)
[994](#994)            .with_inner_margin(Rect::ZERO);
[995](#995)        let inner = block_content_area(&block, area);
[996](#996)        block.render(buf, area);
[997](#997)        if is_empty(inner) {
[998](#998)            return;
[999](#999)        }
[1000](#1000)
[1001](#1001)        let bars_width = inner.width.min(12);
[1002](#1002)        let text_width = inner.width.saturating_sub(bars_width.saturating_add(1));
[1003](#1003)        let max_lines = usize::from(inner.height);
[1004](#1004)
[1005](#1005)        for (index, line) in self.lines.iter().take(max_lines).enumerate() {
[1006](#1006)            paint_text(
[1007](#1007)                Rect::new(inner.x, inner.y + index as u16, text_width, 1),
[1008](#1008)                buf,
[1009](#1009)                line.as_ref(),
[1010](#1010)                Style::default().fg(self.palette.high),
[1011](#1011)            );
[1012](#1012)        }
[1013](#1013)
[1014](#1014)        if bars_width == 0 {
[1015](#1015)            return;
[1016](#1016)        }
[1017](#1017)
[1018](#1018)        let bars_x = inner.x + inner.width.saturating_sub(bars_width);
[1019](#1019)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[1020](#1020)            for column in 0..bars_width {
[1021](#1021)                let x = bars_x + column;
[1022](#1022)                let y = inner.y + row;
[1023](#1023)                let noise = field_noise(x, y, self.tick / 2);
[1024](#1024)                let active = (noise + self.tick + u64::from(column)) % 7 <= 3;
[1025](#1025)                let symbol = if active { '╱' } else { '·' };
[1026](#1026)                let style = if active {
[1027](#1027)                    Style::default()
[1028](#1028)                        .fg(self.palette.lane(noise))
[1029](#1029)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[1030](#1030)                } else {
[1031](#1031)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow)
[1032](#1032)                };
[1033](#1033)                set_styled_char(buf, x, y, symbol, style);
[1034](#1034)            }
[1035](#1035)        }
[1036](#1036)    }
[1037](#1037)}
[1038](#1038)

[1103](#1103)impl Widget for FlickerPanel<'_> {
[1104](#1104)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[1105](#1105)        let inner = self
[1106](#1106)            .block
[1107](#1107)            .as_ref()
[1108](#1108)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[1109](#1109)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[1110](#1110)            block.render(buf, area);
[1111](#1111)        }
[1112](#1112)        if is_empty(inner) || self.intensity == 0 {
[1113](#1113)            return;
[1114](#1114)        }
[1115](#1115)
[1116](#1116)        let glitch_chars: Vec<char> = "░▒▓█▀▄▌▐│┤╡╢╖╕╣║╗╝╜╛┐└┴┬├─┼╞╟╚╔╩╦╠═╬".chars().collect();
[1117](#1117)        let text_chars: Vec<char> = self.text.chars().collect();
[1118](#1118)        if text_chars.is_empty() {
[1119](#1119)            return;
[1120](#1120)        }
[1121](#1121)
[1122](#1122)        let right = inner.x.saturating_add(inner.width);
[1123](#1123)        let bottom = inner.y.saturating_add(inner.height);
[1124](#1124)        for y in inner.y..bottom {
[1125](#1125)            for x in inner.x..right {

[1127](#1127)                let noise = field_noise(x, y, self.tick);
[1128](#1128)                let glitch_gate = 11_u64.saturating_sub(u64::from(self.intensity));
[1129](#1129)

[1131](#1131)                    let g = glitch_chars[(noise as usize) % glitch_chars.len()];
[1132](#1132)                    (
[1133](#1133)                        g,
[1134](#1134)                        Style::default()
[1135](#1135)                            .fg(self.palette.pulse)
[1136](#1136)                            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[1137](#1137)                    )
[1138](#1138)                } else if col < text_chars.len() {
[1139](#1139)                    let c = text_chars[col];
[1140](#1140)                    let flicker = (noise + self.tick) % 9 == 0;
[1141](#1141)                    let style = if flicker {
[1142](#1142)                        Style::default()
[1143](#1143)                            .fg(self.palette.high)
[1144](#1144)                            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[1145](#1145)                    } else {
[1146](#1146)                        Style::default().fg(self.palette.mid)
[1147](#1147)                    };
[1148](#1148)                    (c, style)
[1149](#1149)                } else {
[1150](#1150)                    (' ', Style::default())
[1151](#1151)                };
[1152](#1152)                set_styled_char(buf, x, y, ch, style);
[1153](#1153)            }
[1154](#1154)        }

[1180](#1180)            && self.frequency == other.frequency
[1181](#1181)            && self.amplitude == other.amplitude

[1229](#1229)        self
[1230](#1230)    }
[1231](#1231)
[1232](#1232)    fn sample(&self, phase: f64) -> f64 {
[1233](#1233)        let t = phase.fract();
[1234](#1234)        match self.wave_type {
[1235](#1235)            WaveType::Sine => (std::f64::consts::TAU * t).sin(),
[1236](#1236)            WaveType::Square => {
[1237](#1237)                if t < 0.5 {
[1238](#1238)                    1.0
[1239](#1239)                } else {
[1240](#1240)                    -1.0
[1241](#1241)                }
[1242](#1242)            }
[1243](#1243)            WaveType::Sawtooth => 2.0 * t - 1.0,
[1244](#1244)            WaveType::Triangle => {
[1245](#1245)                if t < 0.5 {
[1246](#1246)                    4.0 * t - 1.0
[1247](#1247)                } else {
[1248](#1248)                    3.0 - 4.0 * t
[1249](#1249)                }
[1250](#1250)            }
[1251](#1251)        }
[1252](#1252)    }
[1253](#1253)}
[1254](#1254)
[1255](#1255)impl Widget for Waveform<'_> {
[1256](#1256)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[1257](#1257)        let inner = self
[1258](#1258)            .block
[1259](#1259)            .as_ref()
[1260](#1260)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[1261](#1261)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[1262](#1262)            block.render(buf, area);
[1263](#1263)        }
[1264](#1264)        if is_empty(inner) || inner.height < 3 {
[1265](#1265)            return;
[1266](#1266)        }
[1267](#1267)
[1268](#1268)        let mid_y = inner.y + inner.height / 2;
[1269](#1269)        let half = (inner.height / 2) as f64;
[1270](#1270)
[1271](#1271)        for col in 0..inner.width {
[1272](#1272)            let phase = f64::from(col) / f64::from(inner.width) * self.frequency
[1273](#1273)                + f64::from(self.tick as u32) * 0.05;
[1274](#1274)            let sample = self.sample(phase);
[1275](#1275)            let offset = (sample * self.amplitude * half).round() as i16;
[1276](#1276)
[1277](#1277)            let y = mid_y as i16 + offset;
[1278](#1278)            if y >= inner.y as i16 && y < (inner.y + inner.height) as i16 {
[1279](#1279)                let noise = field_noise(inner.x + col, y as u16, self.tick);
[1280](#1280)                set_styled_char(
[1281](#1281)                    buf,
[1282](#1282)                    inner.x + col,
[1283](#1283)                    y as u16,
[1284](#1284)                    '█',
[1285](#1285)                    Style::default()
[1286](#1286)                        .fg(self.palette.lane(noise))
[1287](#1287)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[1288](#1288)                );
[1289](#1289)            }
[1290](#1290)        }
[1291](#1291)    }
[1292](#1292)}

[1328](#1328)impl Widget for PulseRing {
[1329](#1329)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[1330](#1330)        if is_empty(area) || self.rings == 0 {
[1331](#1331)            return;
[1332](#1332)        }
[1333](#1333)
[1334](#1334)        let cx = area.x + area.width / 2;
[1335](#1335)        let cy = area.y + area.height / 2;
[1336](#1336)        let max_radius = (area.width.min(area.height) / 2) as f64;
[1337](#1337)        if max_radius < 1.0 {
[1338](#1338)            return;
[1339](#1339)        }
[1340](#1340)
[1341](#1341)        let right = area.x.saturating_add(area.width);
[1342](#1342)        let bottom = area.y.saturating_add(area.height);
[1343](#1343)
[1344](#1344)        for y in area.y..bottom {
[1345](#1345)            for x in area.x..right {
[1346](#1346)                let dx = x as f64 - cx as f64;
[1347](#1347)                let dy = y as f64 - cy as f64;
[1348](#1348)                let dist = (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt();
[1349](#1349)
[1350](#1350)                for ring in 0..self.rings {
[1351](#1351)                    let ring_phase = (self.tick as f64 * 0.1 + ring as f64 * 3.0) % max_radius;
[1352](#1352)                    let diff = (dist - ring_phase).abs();
[1353](#1353)                    if diff < 1.5 {
[1354](#1354)                        let noise = field_noise(x, y, self.tick + ring as u64);
[1355](#1355)                        let style = if diff < 0.8 {
[1356](#1356)                            Style::default()
[1357](#1357)                                .fg(self.palette.high)
[1358](#1358)                                .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[1359](#1359)                        } else {
[1360](#1360)                            Style::default().fg(self.palette.lane(noise))
[1361](#1361)                        };
[1362](#1362)                        set_styled_char(buf, x, y, '○', style);
[1363](#1363)                        break;
[1364](#1364)                    }
[1365](#1365)                }
[1366](#1366)            }
[1367](#1367)        }
[1368](#1368)    }
[1369](#1369)}

[1404](#1404)
[1405](#1405)impl Widget for Radar {
[1406](#1406)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[1407](#1407)        if is_empty(area) {
[1408](#1408)            return;
[1409](#1409)        }
[1410](#1410)
[1411](#1411)        let cx = area.x + area.width / 2;
[1412](#1412)        let cy = area.y + area.height / 2;
[1413](#1413)        let max_r = (area.width.min(area.height) / 2) as f64;
[1414](#1414)        if max_r < 1.0 {
[1415](#1415)            return;
[1416](#1416)        }
[1417](#1417)
[1418](#1418)        let sweep_angle = (self.tick as f64 / self.sweep_speed as f64) % (std::f64::consts::TAU);
[1419](#1419)        let trail_len = std::f64::consts::PI * 0.6;
[1420](#1420)
[1421](#1421)        let right = area.x.saturating_add(area.width);
[1422](#1422)        let bottom = area.y.saturating_add(area.height);
[1423](#1423)
[1424](#1424)        for y in area.y..bottom {
[1425](#1425)            for x in area.x..right {
[1426](#1426)                let dx = x as f64 - cx as f64;
[1427](#1427)                let dy = y as f64 - cy as f64;
[1428](#1428)                let dist = (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt();
[1429](#1429)
[1430](#1430)                if dist > max_r {
[1431](#1431)                    continue;
[1432](#1432)                }
[1433](#1433)
[1434](#1434)                let angle = dy.atan2(dx);
[1435](#1435)                let norm_angle = if angle < 0.0 {
[1436](#1436)                    angle + std::f64::consts::TAU
[1437](#1437)                } else {
[1438](#1438)                    angle
[1439](#1439)                };
[1440](#1440)
[1441](#1441)                let ring = dist as u16;
[1442](#1442)                if ring > 0 && dist % (max_r / 3.0) < 0.5 {
[1443](#1443)                    set_styled_char(buf, x, y, '·', Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow));
[1444](#1444)                    continue;
[1445](#1445)                }
[1446](#1446)
[1447](#1447)                let diff = (norm_angle - sweep_angle).abs();
[1448](#1448)                let diff = if diff > std::f64::consts::PI {
[1449](#1449)                    std::f64::consts::TAU - diff
[1450](#1450)                } else {
[1451](#1451)                    diff
[1452](#1452)                };
[1453](#1453)
[1454](#1454)                if diff < trail_len {
[1455](#1455)                    let fade = 1.0 - diff / trail_len;
[1456](#1456)                    let noise = field_noise(x, y, self.tick);
[1457](#1457)                    let color = if fade > 0.6 {
[1458](#1458)                        self.palette.high
[1459](#1459)                    } else {
[1460](#1460)                        self.palette.lane(noise)
[1461](#1461)                    };
[1462](#1462)                    set_styled_char(
[1463](#1463)                        buf,
[1464](#1464)                        x,
[1465](#1465)                        y,
[1466](#1466)                        if dist < 1.0 { '●' } else { '·' },
[1467](#1467)                        Style::default().fg(color).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[1468](#1468)                    );
[1469](#1469)                } else if (dist - 1.0).abs() < 0.5
[1470](#1470)                    || (dist - max_r * 0.5).abs() < 0.5
[1471](#1471)                    || (dist - max_r * 0.9).abs() < 0.5
[1472](#1472)                {
[1473](#1473)                    set_styled_char(buf, x, y, '·', Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow));
[1474](#1474)                }
[1475](#1475)            }
[1476](#1476)        }
[1477](#1477)    }
[1478](#1478)}
[1479](#1479)

[1501](#1501)    #[must_use]
[1503](#1503)    pub fn new(count: u16) -> Self {
[1504](#1504)        Self {
[1505](#1505)            tick: 0,
[1506](#1506)            count,
[1507](#1507)            palette: AislingPalette::dream(),

[1511](#1511)
[1512](#1512)    #[must_use]
[1514](#1514)    pub fn tick(mut self, tick: u64) -> Self {
[1515](#1515)        self.tick = tick;
[1516](#1516)        self
[1517](#1517)    }
[1518](#1518)
[1519](#1519)    #[must_use]
[1521](#1521)    pub fn palette(mut self, palette: AislingPalette) -> Self {
[1522](#1522)        self.palette = palette;
[1523](#1523)        self
[1524](#1524)    }
[1525](#1525)
[1526](#1526)    #[must_use]
[1528](#1528)    pub fn block(mut self, block: Block<'a>) -> Self {
[1529](#1529)        self.block = Some(block);
[1530](#1530)        self
[1531](#1531)    }
[1532](#1532)}
[1533](#1533)
[1534](#1534)impl Widget for OrbField<'_> {
[1535](#1535)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[1536](#1536)        let inner = self
[1537](#1537)            .block
[1538](#1538)            .as_ref()
[1539](#1539)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[1540](#1540)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[1541](#1541)            block.render(buf, area);
[1542](#1542)        }
[1543](#1543)        if is_empty(inner) || self.count == 0 {
[1544](#1544)            return;
[1545](#1545)        }
[1546](#1546)
[1547](#1547)        for i in 0..u64::from(self.count) {
[1548](#1548)            let seed = field_noise(i as u16, i as u16 / 7, i);
[1549](#1549)            let speed_x = (seed % 7) as f64 * 0.3 + 0.2;
[1550](#1550)            let speed_y = ((seed >> 3) % 5) as f64 * 0.2 + 0.1;
[1551](#1551)            let phase_x = seed as f64 * 0.1;
[1552](#1552)            let phase_y = (seed >> 5) as f64 * 0.13;
[1553](#1553)
[1554](#1554)            let base_x = (inner.x as f64)
[1555](#1555)                + ((self.tick as f64 * speed_x * 0.02 + phase_x).sin() * 0.5 + 0.5)
[1556](#1556)                    * inner.width as f64;
[1557](#1557)            let base_y = (inner.y as f64)
[1558](#1558)                + ((self.tick as f64 * speed_y * 0.02 + phase_y).cos() * 0.5 + 0.5)
[1559](#1559)                    * inner.height as f64;
[1560](#1560)
[1561](#1561)            let px = base_x.round() as u16;
[1562](#1562)            let py = base_y.round() as u16;
[1563](#1563)
[1564](#1564)            if px >= inner.x
[1565](#1565)                && px < inner.x + inner.width
[1566](#1566)                && py >= inner.y
[1567](#1567)                && py < inner.y + inner.height
[1568](#1568)            {
[1569](#1569)                let noise = field_noise(px, py, self.tick + i);
[1570](#1570)                let glyph = if noise % 3 == 0 {
[1571](#1571)                    '◆'
[1572](#1572)                } else if noise % 3 == 1 {
[1573](#1573)                    '◇'
[1574](#1574)                } else {
[1575](#1575)                    '•'
[1576](#1576)                };
[1577](#1577)                set_styled_char(
[1578](#1578)                    buf,
[1579](#1579)                    px,
[1580](#1580)                    py,
[1581](#1581)                    glyph,
[1582](#1582)                    Style::default()
[1583](#1583)                        .fg(self.palette.lane(i))
[1584](#1584)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[1585](#1585)                );
[1586](#1586)            }
[1587](#1587)        }
[1588](#1588)    }

[1593](#1593)pub struct NeonBorder<'a> {
[1594](#1594)    tick: u64,
[1595](#1595)    speed: u64,
[1596](#1596)    palette: AislingPalette,
[1597](#1597)    inner: Block<'a>,
[1598](#1598)}
[1599](#1599)
[1600](#1600)impl PartialEq for NeonBorder<'_> {
[1601](#1601)    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
[1602](#1602)        self.tick == other.tick
[1603](#1603)            && self.speed == other.speed
[1604](#1604)            && self.palette == other.palette
[1605](#1605)            && block_eq(&self.inner, &other.inner)
[1606](#1606)    }
[1607](#1607)}
[1608](#1608)
[1609](#1609)impl<'a> NeonBorder<'a> {
[1610](#1610)    #[must_use]
[1612](#1612)    pub fn new(inner: Block<'a>) -> Self {
[1613](#1613)        Self {
[1614](#1614)            tick: 0,
[1615](#1615)            speed: 3,
[1616](#1616)            palette: AislingPalette::dream(),
[1617](#1617)            inner,
[1618](#1618)        }
[1619](#1619)    }
[1620](#1620)
[1621](#1621)    #[must_use]
[1623](#1623)    pub fn tick(mut self, tick: u64) -> Self {
[1624](#1624)        self.tick = tick;
[1625](#1625)        self
[1626](#1626)    }
[1627](#1627)
[1628](#1628)    #[must_use]
[1630](#1630)    pub fn speed(mut self, speed: u64) -> Self {
[1631](#1631)        self.speed = speed.max(1);
[1632](#1632)        self
[1633](#1633)    }
[1634](#1634)
[1635](#1635)    #[must_use]
[1637](#1637)    pub fn palette(mut self, palette: AislingPalette) -> Self {
[1638](#1638)        self.palette = palette;
[1639](#1639)        self
[1640](#1640)    }
[1641](#1641)
[1642](#1642)    pub fn render_border(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) -> Rect {
[1644](#1644)        let inner = block_content_area(&self.inner, area);
[1645](#1645)
[1646](#1646)        let right = area.x.saturating_add(area.width);
[1647](#1647)        let bottom = area.y.saturating_add(area.height);
[1648](#1648)        let perimeter = 2 * (area.width + area.height) as u64;
[1649](#1649)
[1650](#1650)        for y in area.y..bottom {
[1651](#1651)            for x in area.x..right {
[1652](#1652)                if !is_edge(area, x, y) {
[1653](#1653)                    continue;
[1654](#1654)                }
[1655](#1655)
[1656](#1656)                let pos = if y == area.y {
[1657](#1657)                    u64::from(x - area.x)
[1658](#1658)                } else if x + 1 == right {
[1659](#1659)                    u64::from(area.width) + u64::from(y - area.y)
[1660](#1660)                } else if y + 1 == bottom {
[1661](#1661)                    u64::from(area.width + area.height) + u64::from(right - x - 1)
[1662](#1662)                } else {
[1663](#1663)                    u64::from(2 * area.width + area.height) + u64::from(bottom - y - 1)
[1664](#1664)                };
[1665](#1665)
[1666](#1666)                let phase = (self.tick * self.speed + pos) % perimeter;
[1667](#1667)                let color_idx = (phase * 4 / perimeter) as usize;
[1668](#1668)                let color = match color_idx {
[1669](#1669)                    0 => self.palette.low,
[1670](#1670)                    1 => self.palette.mid,
[1671](#1671)                    2 => self.palette.high,
[1672](#1672)                    _ => self.palette.pulse,
[1673](#1673)                };
[1674](#1674)
[1675](#1675)                let ch = if y == area.y || y + 1 == bottom {
[1676](#1676)                    '─'
[1677](#1677)                } else {
[1678](#1678)                    '│'
[1679](#1679)                };
[1680](#1680)                set_styled_char(
[1681](#1681)                    buf,
[1682](#1682)                    x,
[1683](#1683)                    y,
[1684](#1684)                    ch,
[1685](#1685)                    Style::default().fg(color).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[1686](#1686)                );
[1687](#1687)            }
[1688](#1688)        }
[1689](#1689)
[1690](#1690)        inner
[1691](#1691)    }
[1692](#1692)}
[1693](#1693)
[1694](#1694)impl Widget for NeonBorder<'_> {
[1695](#1695)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[1696](#1696)        self.render_border(buf, area);
[1697](#1697)    }
[1698](#1698)}

[1806](#1806)    pub fn render_with_interaction(
[1808](#1808)        &self,
[1809](#1809)        frame: &mut Frame<'_>,
[1810](#1810)        id: impl Into<WidgetId>,
[1811](#1811)        area: Rect,
[1812](#1812)    ) {
[1813](#1813)        let id = id.into();
[1814](#1814)        self.render(frame.buffer(), area);
[1815](#1815)        for region in self.hit_regions(id.clone(), area) {
[1816](#1816)            frame.register_hit_region(region);
[1817](#1817)        }
[1818](#1818)        for span in self.selectable_spans(id.clone(), area) {
[1819](#1819)            frame.register_selectable_span(span);
[1820](#1820)        }
[1821](#1821)        if let Some((viewport, start, rows)) = self.scroll_region(id.clone(), area) {
[1822](#1822)            frame.register_scroll_region(id, viewport, start, rows);
[1823](#1823)        }
[1824](#1824)        frame.mark_dirty(area);
[1825](#1825)    }
[1826](#1826)
[1827](#1827)    #[must_use]
[1829](#1829)    pub fn hit_regions(&self, id: impl Into<WidgetId>, area: Rect) -> Vec<HitRegion> {
[1830](#1830)        let region_id = id.into();
[1831](#1831)        let inner = self
[1832](#1832)            .block
[1833](#1833)            .as_ref()
[1834](#1834)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[1835](#1835)        if is_empty(area) || is_empty(inner) {
[1836](#1836)            return Vec::new();
[1837](#1837)        }
[1838](#1838)
[1839](#1839)        let mut regions = vec![
[1840](#1840)            HitRegion::new(region_id.clone(), area)
[1841](#1841)                .with_role(WidgetRole::Transcript)
[1842](#1842)                .with_label("stream")
[1843](#1843)                .with_value(WidgetValue::Count(self.lines.len())),
[1844](#1844)        ];
[1845](#1845)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[1846](#1846)
[1847](#1847)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[1848](#1848)            let line_idx = start + row as usize;
[1849](#1849)            if line_idx >= self.lines.len() {
[1850](#1850)                break;
[1851](#1851)            }
[1852](#1852)
[1853](#1853)            let row_area = Rect::new(inner.x, inner.y + row, inner.width, 1);
[1854](#1854)            regions.push(
[1855](#1855)                HitRegion::new(format!("{}:line:{line_idx}", region_id.as_ref()), row_area)
[1856](#1856)                    .with_role(WidgetRole::TranscriptRow)
[1857](#1857)                    .with_label(self.lines[line_idx].as_ref())
[1858](#1858)                    .with_action(WidgetAction::Select)
[1859](#1859)                    .with_cursor(MouseCursor::Text)
[1860](#1860)                    .with_row(line_idx)
[1861](#1861)                    .with_value(WidgetValue::LineNumber(line_idx + 1))
[1862](#1862)                    .with_z_index(1),
[1863](#1863)            );
[1864](#1864)        }
[1865](#1865)
[1866](#1866)        regions
[1867](#1867)    }
[1868](#1868)
[1869](#1869)    #[must_use]
[1871](#1871)    pub fn selectable_spans(&self, id: impl Into<WidgetId>, area: Rect) -> Vec<SelectableSpan> {
[1872](#1872)        let region_id = id.into();
[1873](#1873)        let inner = self
[1874](#1874)            .block
[1875](#1875)            .as_ref()
[1876](#1876)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[1877](#1877)        if is_empty(inner) {
[1878](#1878)            return Vec::new();
[1879](#1879)        }
[1880](#1880)
[1881](#1881)        let gutter_width = self.gutter_width();
[1882](#1882)        let text_width = inner.width.saturating_sub(gutter_width);
[1883](#1883)        if text_width == 0 {
[1884](#1884)            return Vec::new();
[1885](#1885)        }
[1886](#1886)
[1887](#1887)        let group = SelectionGroup::new(format!("{}:lines", region_id.as_ref()));
[1888](#1888)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[1889](#1889)        let mut spans = Vec::new();
[1890](#1890)
[1891](#1891)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[1892](#1892)            let line_idx = start + row as usize;
[1893](#1893)            if line_idx >= self.lines.len() {
[1894](#1894)                break;
[1895](#1895)            }
[1896](#1896)
[1897](#1897)            let text = clipped_text(self.lines[line_idx].as_ref(), text_width);
[1898](#1898)            if text.is_empty() {
[1899](#1899)                continue;
[1900](#1900)            }
[1901](#1901)
[1902](#1902)            let width = text.chars().count().min(usize::from(text_width)) as u16;
[1903](#1903)            spans.push(
[1904](#1904)                SelectableSpan::from_logical(
[1905](#1905)                    format!("{}:span:{line_idx}", region_id.as_ref()),
[1906](#1906)                    region_id.clone(),
[1907](#1907)                    Rect::new(inner.x + gutter_width, inner.y + row, width, 1),
[1908](#1908)                    TextRange::new(line_idx, 0, width as usize),
[1909](#1909)                    text,
[1910](#1910)                )
[1911](#1911)                .with_group(group.clone()),
[1912](#1912)            );
[1913](#1913)        }
[1914](#1914)
[1915](#1915)        spans
[1916](#1916)    }
[1917](#1917)
[1918](#1918)    #[must_use]
[1920](#1920)    pub fn scroll_region(
[1921](#1921)        &self,
[1922](#1922)        id: impl Into<WidgetId>,
[1923](#1923)        area: Rect,
[1924](#1924)    ) -> Option<(Rect, usize, Vec<ScrollRowHit>)> {
[1925](#1925)        let region_id = id.into();
[1926](#1926)        let inner = self
[1927](#1927)            .block
[1928](#1928)            .as_ref()
[1929](#1929)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[1930](#1930)        if is_empty(inner) {
[1931](#1931)            return None;
[1932](#1932)        }
[1933](#1933)
[1934](#1934)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[1935](#1935)        let mut rows = Vec::new();
[1936](#1936)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[1937](#1937)            let line_idx = start + row as usize;
[1938](#1938)            if line_idx >= self.lines.len() {
[1939](#1939)                break;
[1940](#1940)            }
[1941](#1941)            let row_id = WidgetId::new(format!("{}:line:{line_idx}", region_id.as_ref()));
[1942](#1942)            rows.push(
[1943](#1943)                ScrollRowHit::new(row_id.clone(), line_idx)
[1944](#1944)                    .with_source_line(line_idx)
[1945](#1945)                    .with_span_id(format!("{}:span:{line_idx}", region_id.as_ref()))
[1946](#1946)                    .with_item_id(row_id),
[1947](#1947)            );
[1948](#1948)        }
[1949](#1949)
[1950](#1950)        Some((inner, start, rows))
[1951](#1951)    }
[1952](#1952)
[1953](#1953)    #[must_use]
[1955](#1955)    pub fn line_count(&self) -> usize {
[1956](#1956)        self.lines.len()
[1957](#1957)    }
[1958](#1958)
[1959](#1959)    fn gutter_width(&self) -> u16 {
[1960](#1960)        if self.show_line_numbers {
[1961](#1961)            let max_num = self.lines.len().max(1);
[1962](#1962)            let digits = format!("{max_num}").len() as u16;
[1963](#1963)            digits + 1
[1964](#1964)        } else {
[1965](#1965)            0
[1966](#1966)        }
[1967](#1967)    }
[1968](#1968)
[1969](#1969)    fn visible_start(&self, visible_height: u16) -> usize {
[1971](#1971)        let total = self.lines.len() as u16;
[1972](#1972)        if self.follow_tail || self.scroll_offset == 0 {
[1973](#1973)            let shown = visible_height.min(total);
[1974](#1974)            (total - shown) as usize
[1975](#1975)        } else {
[1976](#1976)            let max_top = total.saturating_sub(visible_height);
[1977](#1977)            (max_top.saturating_sub(self.scroll_offset)) as usize
[1978](#1978)        }
[1979](#1979)    }
[1980](#1980)}

[1982](#1982)impl Default for StreamPanel<'_> {
[1983](#1983)    fn default() -> Self {
[1984](#1984)        Self::new()
[1985](#1985)    }
[1986](#1986)}
[1987](#1987)
[1988](#1988)impl Widget for StreamPanel<'_> {
[1989](#1989)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[1990](#1990)        let inner = self
[1991](#1991)            .block
[1992](#1992)            .as_ref()
[1993](#1993)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[1994](#1994)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[1995](#1995)            block.render(buf, area);
[1996](#1996)        }
[1997](#1997)        if is_empty(inner) {
[1998](#1998)            return;
[1999](#1999)        }
[2000](#2000)
[2001](#2001)        let gutter_width = self.gutter_width();
[2002](#2002)
[2003](#2003)        let text_width = inner.width.saturating_sub(gutter_width);
[2004](#2004)        if text_width == 0 {
[2005](#2005)            return;
[2006](#2006)        }
[2007](#2007)
[2008](#2008)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[2009](#2009)        let right = inner.x.saturating_add(inner.width);
[2010](#2010)        let total = self.lines.len();
[2011](#2011)
[2012](#2012)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[2013](#2013)            let line_idx = start + row as usize;
[2014](#2014)            let y = inner.y + row;
[2015](#2015)
[2016](#2016)            if line_idx >= total {
[2017](#2017)                break;
[2018](#2018)            }
[2019](#2019)
[2020](#2020)            if self.show_line_numbers {
[2021](#2021)                let num_str = format!(
[2022](#2022)                    "{:>width$}",
[2023](#2023)                    line_idx + 1,
[2024](#2024)                    width = (gutter_width - 1) as usize
[2025](#2025)                );
[2026](#2026)                paint_text(
[2027](#2027)                    Rect::new(inner.x, y, gutter_width.saturating_sub(1), 1),
[2028](#2028)                    buf,
[2029](#2029)                    &num_str,
[2030](#2030)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow),
[2031](#2031)                );
[2032](#2032)                set_styled_char(
[2033](#2033)                    buf,
[2034](#2034)                    inner.x + gutter_width - 1,
[2035](#2035)                    y,
[2036](#2036)                    '│',
[2037](#2037)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow),
[2038](#2038)                );
[2039](#2039)            }
[2040](#2040)
[2041](#2041)            let line = &self.lines[line_idx];
[2042](#2042)            let text_chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
[2043](#2043)
[2044](#2044)            for col in 0..text_width {
[2045](#2045)                let x = inner.x + gutter_width + col;
[2046](#2046)                if x >= right {
[2047](#2047)                    break;
[2048](#2048)                }
[2049](#2049)                let ch = text_chars.get(col as usize).copied().unwrap_or(' ');
[2050](#2050)                let noise = field_noise(x, y, self.tick);
[2051](#2051)                let style = if ch == ' ' {
[2052](#2052)                    Style::default()
[2053](#2053)                } else if (noise + self.tick) % 31 == 0 {
[2054](#2054)                    Style::default()
[2055](#2055)                        .fg(self.palette.pulse)
[2056](#2056)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[2057](#2057)                } else {
[2058](#2058)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.high)
[2059](#2059)                };
[2060](#2060)                set_styled_char(buf, x, y, ch, style);
[2061](#2061)            }
[2062](#2062)        }
[2063](#2063)
[2064](#2064)        if !self.follow_tail && self.scroll_offset > 0 {
[2065](#2065)            let indicator_y = inner.y;
[2066](#2066)            let indicator_style = Style::default()
[2067](#2067)                .fg(self.palette.pulse)
[2068](#2068)                .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
[2069](#2069)            if inner.width > 2 {
[2070](#2070)                set_styled_char(buf, right - 2, indicator_y, '▲', indicator_style);
[2071](#2071)            }
[2072](#2072)        }
[2073](#2073)    }
[2074](#2074)}

[2132](#2132)    pub fn split(&self, area: Rect) -> (Rect, Rect, Rect) {
[2135](#2135)        if is_empty(area) {
[2136](#2136)            return (Rect::ZERO, Rect::ZERO, Rect::ZERO);
[2137](#2137)        }
[2138](#2138)
[2139](#2139)        match self.direction {
[2140](#2140)            SplitDirection::Vertical => {
[2141](#2141)                let has_divider = self.divider.is_some() && area.width > 1;
[2142](#2142)                let available = if has_divider {
[2143](#2143)                    area.width.saturating_sub(1)
[2144](#2144)                } else {
[2145](#2145)                    area.width
[2146](#2146)                };
[2147](#2147)                let first_width = (f64::from(available) * self.ratio).round() as u16;
[2148](#2148)                let second_width = available.saturating_sub(first_width);
[2149](#2149)
[2150](#2150)                let a = Rect::new(area.x, area.y, first_width, area.height);
[2151](#2151)                let div = if has_divider {
[2152](#2152)                    Rect::new(area.x + first_width, area.y, 1, area.height)
[2153](#2153)                } else {
[2154](#2154)                    Rect::ZERO
[2155](#2155)                };
[2156](#2156)                let b_x = area.x + first_width + if has_divider { 1 } else { 0 };
[2157](#2157)                let b = Rect::new(b_x, area.y, second_width, area.height);
[2158](#2158)                (a, b, div)
[2159](#2159)            }
[2160](#2160)            SplitDirection::Horizontal => {
[2161](#2161)                let has_divider = self.divider.is_some() && area.height > 1;
[2162](#2162)                let available = if has_divider {
[2163](#2163)                    area.height.saturating_sub(1)
[2164](#2164)                } else {
[2165](#2165)                    area.height
[2166](#2166)                };
[2167](#2167)                let first_height = (f64::from(available) * self.ratio).round() as u16;
[2168](#2168)                let second_height = available.saturating_sub(first_height);
[2169](#2169)
[2170](#2170)                let a = Rect::new(area.x, area.y, area.width, first_height);
[2171](#2171)                let div = if has_divider {
[2172](#2172)                    Rect::new(area.x, area.y + first_height, area.width, 1)
[2173](#2173)                } else {
[2174](#2174)                    Rect::ZERO
[2175](#2175)                };
[2176](#2176)                let b_y = area.y + first_height + if has_divider { 1 } else { 0 };
[2177](#2177)                let b = Rect::new(area.x, b_y, area.width, second_height);
[2178](#2178)                (a, b, div)
[2179](#2179)            }
[2180](#2180)        }
[2181](#2181)    }
[2182](#2182)
[2183](#2183)    pub fn render_divider(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, divider_area: Rect, palette: AislingPalette) {
[2185](#2185)        if is_empty(divider_area) {
[2186](#2186)            return;
[2187](#2187)        }
[2188](#2188)        let ch = self.divider.unwrap_or(' ');
[2189](#2189)        let style = Style::default().fg(palette.mid);
[2190](#2190)        for y in divider_area.y..divider_area.y.saturating_add(divider_area.height) {
[2191](#2191)            for x in divider_area.x..divider_area.x.saturating_add(divider_area.width) {
[2192](#2192)                set_styled_char(buf, x, y, ch, style);
[2193](#2193)            }
[2194](#2194)        }
[2195](#2195)    }
[2196](#2196)}

[2314](#2314)    pub fn hit_regions(&self, id: impl Into<WidgetId>, area: Rect) -> Vec<HitRegion> {

[2316](#2316)        let inner = self
[2317](#2317)            .block

[2319](#2319)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));

[2357](#2357)    #[must_use]
[2359](#2359)    pub fn selectable_spans(&self, id: impl Into<WidgetId>, area: Rect) -> Vec<SelectableSpan> {
[2360](#2360)        let region_id = id.into();
[2361](#2361)        let inner = self
[2362](#2362)            .block
[2363](#2363)            .as_ref()
[2364](#2364)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2365](#2365)        if is_empty(inner) {
[2366](#2366)            return Vec::new();
[2367](#2367)        }
[2368](#2368)
[2369](#2369)        let text_x = inner.x.saturating_add(2);
[2370](#2370)        let text_width = inner.width.saturating_sub(2);
[2371](#2371)        if text_width == 0 {
[2372](#2372)            return Vec::new();
[2373](#2373)        }
[2374](#2374)
[2375](#2375)        let group = SelectionGroup::new(format!("{}:items", region_id.as_ref()));
[2376](#2376)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[2377](#2377)        let mut spans = Vec::new();
[2378](#2378)
[2379](#2379)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[2380](#2380)            let item_idx = start + row as usize;
[2381](#2381)            if item_idx >= self.items.len() {
[2382](#2382)                break;
[2383](#2383)            }
[2384](#2384)
[2385](#2385)            let text = clipped_text(self.items[item_idx].as_ref(), text_width);
[2386](#2386)            if text.is_empty() {
[2387](#2387)                continue;
[2388](#2388)            }
[2389](#2389)
[2390](#2390)            let width = text.chars().count().min(usize::from(text_width)) as u16;
[2391](#2391)            spans.push(
[2392](#2392)                SelectableSpan::from_logical(
[2393](#2393)                    format!("{}:span:{item_idx}", region_id.as_ref()),
[2394](#2394)                    region_id.clone(),
[2395](#2395)                    Rect::new(text_x, inner.y + row, width, 1),
[2396](#2396)                    TextRange::new(item_idx, 0, width as usize),
[2397](#2397)                    text,
[2398](#2398)                )
[2399](#2399)                .with_group(group.clone()),
[2400](#2400)            );
[2401](#2401)        }
[2402](#2402)
[2403](#2403)        spans
[2404](#2404)    }
[2405](#2405)
[2406](#2406)    #[must_use]

[2421](#2421)
[2422](#2422)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);

[2433](#2433)                    .with_item_id(row_id),
[2434](#2434)            );

[2438](#2438)    }

[2440](#2440)    #[must_use]
[2442](#2442)    pub fn item_count(&self) -> usize {

[2444](#2444)    }
[2445](#2445)
[2446](#2446)    fn visible_start(&self, visible_height: u16) -> usize {
[2447](#2447)        let total = self.items.len() as u16;
[2448](#2448)        if let Some(sel) = self.selected {
[2449](#2449)            let sel = sel as u16;
[2450](#2450)            if sel < self.scroll_offset {
[2451](#2451)                return sel as usize;
[2452](#2452)            }
[2453](#2453)            if sel >= self.scroll_offset + visible_height {
[2454](#2454)                return (sel + 1 - visible_height) as usize;
[2455](#2455)            }
[2456](#2456)            return self.scroll_offset as usize;
[2457](#2457)        }
[2458](#2458)        let max_top = total.saturating_sub(visible_height);
[2459](#2459)        (self.scroll_offset.min(max_top)) as usize
[2460](#2460)    }

[2469](#2469)impl Widget for List<'_> {
[2470](#2470)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[2471](#2471)        let inner = self
[2472](#2472)            .block
[2473](#2473)            .as_ref()
[2474](#2474)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2475](#2475)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[2476](#2476)            block.render(buf, area);
[2477](#2477)        }
[2478](#2478)        if is_empty(inner) {
[2479](#2479)            return;
[2480](#2480)        }
[2481](#2481)
[2482](#2482)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[2483](#2483)        let indicator_width = 2u16;
[2484](#2484)        let text_width = inner.width.saturating_sub(indicator_width);
[2485](#2485)
[2486](#2486)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[2487](#2487)            let idx = start + row as usize;
[2488](#2488)            let y = inner.y + row;
[2489](#2489)
[2490](#2490)            if idx >= self.items.len() {
[2491](#2491)                break;
[2492](#2492)            }
[2493](#2493)
[2494](#2494)            let is_selected = self.selected == Some(idx);
[2495](#2495)
[2496](#2496)            let indicator = if is_selected { "▸ " } else { "  " };
[2497](#2497)            let indicator_style = if is_selected {
[2498](#2498)                Style::default()
[2499](#2499)                    .fg(self.palette.pulse)
[2500](#2500)                    .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[2501](#2501)            } else {
[2502](#2502)                Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow)
[2503](#2503)            };
[2504](#2504)            paint_text(
[2505](#2505)                Rect::new(inner.x, y, indicator_width, 1),
[2506](#2506)                buf,
[2507](#2507)                indicator,
[2508](#2508)                indicator_style,
[2509](#2509)            );
[2510](#2510)
[2511](#2511)            let item = &self.items[idx];
[2512](#2512)            let item_chars: Vec<char> = item.chars().collect();
[2513](#2513)
[2514](#2514)            for col in 0..text_width {
[2515](#2515)                let x = inner.x + indicator_width + col;
[2516](#2516)                let ch = item_chars.get(col as usize).copied().unwrap_or(' ');
[2517](#2517)                let style = if is_selected {
[2518](#2518)                    if ch == ' ' {
[2519](#2519)                        Style::default().bg(self.palette.shadow)
[2520](#2520)                    } else {
[2521](#2521)                        Style::default()
[2522](#2522)                            .fg(self.palette.high)
[2523](#2523)                            .bg(self.palette.shadow)
[2524](#2524)                            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[2525](#2525)                    }
[2526](#2526)                } else if ch == ' ' {
[2527](#2527)                    Style::default()
[2528](#2528)                } else {
[2529](#2529)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.high)
[2530](#2530)                };
[2531](#2531)                set_styled_char(buf, x, y, ch, style);
[2532](#2532)            }
[2533](#2533)        }
[2534](#2534)    }

[2634](#2634)            HitRegion::new(region_id.clone(), area)

[2636](#2636)                .with_label("tabs")
[2637](#2637)                .with_value(WidgetValue::Count(self.tabs.len())),
[2638](#2638)        ];
[2639](#2639)        let mut x = inner.x;
[2640](#2640)        let right = inner.x.saturating_add(inner.width);
[2641](#2641)
[2642](#2642)        for (idx, tab) in self.tabs.iter().enumerate() {
[2643](#2643)            if x >= right {
[2644](#2644)                break;
[2645](#2645)            }
[2646](#2646)
[2647](#2647)            let label_width = tab.chars().count() as u16;
[2648](#2648)            let tab_width = label_width.saturating_add(4).min(right - x);
[2649](#2649)            if tab_width == 0 {
[2650](#2650)                break;
[2651](#2651)            }
[2652](#2652)
[2653](#2653)            regions.push(
[2654](#2654)                HitRegion::new(
[2655](#2655)                    format!("{}:tab:{idx}", region_id.as_ref()),
[2656](#2656)                    Rect::new(x, inner.y, tab_width, 1),
[2657](#2657)                )
[2658](#2658)                .with_role(WidgetRole::Tab)
[2659](#2659)                .with_label(tab.as_ref())
[2660](#2660)                .with_action(WidgetAction::Focus)
[2661](#2661)                .with_cursor(MouseCursor::Pointer)
[2662](#2662)                .with_row(idx)
[2663](#2663)                .with_shortcut(format!("{}", idx + 1))
[2664](#2664)                .with_state(WidgetState::default().selected(idx == self.selected))
[2665](#2665)                .with_z_index(1),
[2666](#2666)            );
[2667](#2667)
[2668](#2668)            x = x.saturating_add(tab_width);
[2669](#2669)        }
[2670](#2670)
[2671](#2671)        regions
[2672](#2672)    }
[2673](#2673)
[2674](#2674)    #[must_use]
[2676](#2676)    pub fn tab_count(&self) -> usize {
[2677](#2677)        self.tabs.len()
[2678](#2678)    }
[2679](#2679)}
[2680](#2680)
[2681](#2681)impl Widget for TabBar<'_> {
[2682](#2682)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[2683](#2683)        let inner = self
[2684](#2684)            .block
[2685](#2685)            .as_ref()
[2686](#2686)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2687](#2687)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[2688](#2688)            block.render(buf, area);
[2689](#2689)        }
[2690](#2690)        if is_empty(inner) {
[2691](#2691)            return;
[2692](#2692)        }
[2693](#2693)
[2694](#2694)        let mut x = inner.x;
[2695](#2695)        let right = inner.x.saturating_add(inner.width);
[2696](#2696)
[2697](#2697)        for (i, tab) in self.tabs.iter().enumerate() {
[2698](#2698)            if x >= right {
[2699](#2699)                break;
[2700](#2700)            }
[2701](#2701)
[2702](#2702)            let is_selected = i == self.selected;
[2703](#2703)            let label: Vec<char> = tab.chars().collect();
[2704](#2704)            let padding = 2u16;
[2705](#2705)            let tab_width = (label.len() as u16 + padding * 2).min(right - x);
[2706](#2706)
[2707](#2707)            if is_selected {
[2708](#2708)                set_styled_char(
[2709](#2709)                    buf,
[2710](#2710)                    x,
[2711](#2711)                    inner.y,
[2712](#2712)                    '㎍',
[2713](#2713)                    Style::default()
[2714](#2714)                        .fg(self.palette.pulse)
[2715](#2715)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[2716](#2716)                );
[2717](#2717)            } else {
[2718](#2718)                set_styled_char(buf, x, inner.y, ' ', Style::default());
[2719](#2719)            }
[2720](#2720)
[2721](#2721)            for col in 0..tab_width {
[2722](#2722)                let cx = x + col;
[2723](#2723)                if cx >= right {
[2724](#2724)                    break;
[2725](#2725)                }
[2726](#2726)
[2727](#2727)                let char_idx = col.saturating_sub(padding) as usize;
[2728](#2728)                let ch = if col < padding || col >= tab_width - padding {
[2729](#2729)                    ' '
[2730](#2730)                } else if char_idx < label.len() {
[2731](#2731)                    label[char_idx]
[2732](#2732)                } else {
[2733](#2733)                    ' '
[2734](#2734)                };
[2735](#2735)
[2736](#2736)                let style = if is_selected {
[2737](#2737)                    Style::default()
[2738](#2738)                        .fg(self.palette.high)
[2739](#2739)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[2740](#2740)                } else {
[2741](#2741)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.mid)
[2742](#2742)                };
[2743](#2743)                set_styled_char(buf, cx, inner.y, ch, style);
[2744](#2744)            }
[2745](#2745)
[2746](#2746)            if is_selected {
[2747](#2747)                let bottom = inner.y + inner.height.saturating_sub(1);
[2748](#2748)                for col in 0..tab_width {
[2749](#2749)                    let cx = x + col;
[2750](#2750)                    if cx >= right {
[2751](#2751)                        break;
[2752](#2752)                    }
[2753](#2753)                    set_styled_char(
[2754](#2754)                        buf,
[2755](#2755)                        cx,
[2756](#2756)                        bottom,
[2757](#2757)                        '─',
[2758](#2758)                        Style::default().fg(self.palette.pulse),
[2759](#2759)                    );
[2760](#2760)                }
[2761](#2761)            }
[2762](#2762)
[2763](#2763)            x += tab_width;
[2764](#2764)        }
[2765](#2765)    }
[2766](#2766)}

[2788](#2788)            && self.rows == other.rows
[2789](#2789)            && self.widths == other.widths
[2790](#2790)            && self.selected == other.selected

[2792](#2792)            && self.tick == other.tick

[2907](#2907)    #[must_use]
[2909](#2909)    pub fn hit_regions(&self, id: impl Into<WidgetId>, area: Rect) -> Vec<HitRegion> {
[2910](#2910)        let region_id = id.into();
[2911](#2911)        let inner = self
[2912](#2912)            .block
[2913](#2913)            .as_ref()
[2914](#2914)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2915](#2915)        if is_empty(area) || is_empty(inner) {
[2916](#2916)            return Vec::new();
[2917](#2917)        }
[2918](#2918)
[2919](#2919)        let mut regions = vec![
[2920](#2920)            HitRegion::new(region_id.clone(), area)
[2921](#2921)                .with_role(WidgetRole::Region)
[2922](#2922)                .with_label("table")
[2923](#2923)                .with_value(WidgetValue::Count(self.rows.len())),
[2924](#2924)        ];
[2925](#2925)        if self.headers.is_empty() || inner.height < 3 {
[2926](#2926)            return regions;
[2927](#2927)        }
[2928](#2928)
[2929](#2929)        let visible_rows = inner.height.saturating_sub(2);
[2930](#2930)        let start = self
[2931](#2931)            .scroll_offset
[2932](#2932)            .min((self.rows.len() as u16).saturating_sub(visible_rows.min(self.rows.len() as u16)));
[2933](#2933)
[2934](#2934)        for row_offset in 0..visible_rows {
[2935](#2935)            let row_idx = start as usize + row_offset as usize;
[2936](#2936)            if row_idx >= self.rows.len() {
[2937](#2937)                break;
[2938](#2938)            }
[2939](#2939)
[2940](#2940)            let y = inner.y + 2 + row_offset;
[2941](#2941)            let selected = self.selected == Some(row_idx);
[2942](#2942)            let label = self.rows[row_idx]
[2943](#2943)                .iter()
[2944](#2944)                .map(Cow::as_ref)
[2945](#2945)                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
[2946](#2946)                .join(" | ");
[2947](#2947)            regions.push(
[2948](#2948)                HitRegion::new(
[2949](#2949)                    format!("{}:row:{row_idx}", region_id.as_ref()),
[2950](#2950)                    Rect::new(inner.x, y, inner.width, 1),
[2951](#2951)                )
[2952](#2952)                .with_role(WidgetRole::ModelRow)
[2953](#2953)                .with_label(label)
[2954](#2954)                .with_action(WidgetAction::Focus)
[2955](#2955)                .with_cursor(MouseCursor::Pointer)
[2956](#2956)                .with_row(row_idx)
[2957](#2957)                .with_state(WidgetState::default().selected(selected))
[2958](#2958)                .with_value(WidgetValue::Count(self.rows[row_idx].len()))
[2959](#2959)                .with_z_index(1),
[2960](#2960)            );
[2961](#2961)        }
[2962](#2962)
[2963](#2963)        regions
[2964](#2964)    }
[2965](#2965)
[2966](#2966)    #[must_use]
[2968](#2968)    pub fn selectable_spans(&self, id: impl Into<WidgetId>, area: Rect) -> Vec<SelectableSpan> {
[2969](#2969)        let region_id = id.into();
[2970](#2970)        let inner = self
[2971](#2971)            .block
[2972](#2972)            .as_ref()
[2973](#2973)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2974](#2974)        let Some((viewport, start, _)) = self.scroll_region(region_id.clone(), area) else {
[2975](#2975)            return Vec::new();
[2976](#2976)        };
[2977](#2977)        if self.headers.is_empty() || is_empty(inner) || is_empty(viewport) {
[2978](#2978)            return Vec::new();
[2979](#2979)        }
[2980](#2980)
[2981](#2981)        let group = SelectionGroup::new(format!("{}:rows", region_id.as_ref()));
[2982](#2982)        let mut spans = Vec::new();
[2983](#2983)        for row_offset in 0..viewport.height {
[2984](#2984)            let row_idx = start + row_offset as usize;
[2985](#2985)            if row_idx >= self.rows.len() {
[2986](#2986)                break;
[2987](#2987)            }
[2988](#2988)
[2989](#2989)            let text = clipped_text(&self.row_label(row_idx), viewport.width);
[2990](#2990)            if text.is_empty() {
[2991](#2991)                continue;
[2992](#2992)            }
[2993](#2993)
[2994](#2994)            let width = text.chars().count().min(usize::from(viewport.width)) as u16;
[2995](#2995)            spans.push(
[2996](#2996)                SelectableSpan::from_logical(
[2997](#2997)                    format!("{}:span:{row_idx}", region_id.as_ref()),
[2998](#2998)                    region_id.clone(),
[2999](#2999)                    Rect::new(viewport.x, viewport.y + row_offset, width, 1),
[3000](#3000)                    TextRange::new(row_idx, 0, width as usize),
[3001](#3001)                    text,
[3002](#3002)                )
[3003](#3003)                .with_group(group.clone()),
[3004](#3004)            );
[3005](#3005)        }
[3006](#3006)
[3007](#3007)        spans
[3008](#3008)    }
[3009](#3009)
[3010](#3010)    #[must_use]
[3012](#3012)    pub fn scroll_region(
[3013](#3013)        &self,
[3014](#3014)        id: impl Into<WidgetId>,
[3015](#3015)        area: Rect,
[3016](#3016)    ) -> Option<(Rect, usize, Vec<ScrollRowHit>)> {
[3017](#3017)        let region_id = id.into();
[3018](#3018)        let inner = self
[3019](#3019)            .block
[3020](#3020)            .as_ref()
[3021](#3021)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[3022](#3022)        if self.headers.is_empty() || inner.height < 3 || is_empty(inner) {
[3023](#3023)            return None;
[3024](#3024)        }
[3025](#3025)
[3026](#3026)        let visible_rows = inner.height.saturating_sub(2);
[3027](#3027)        let viewport = Rect::new(inner.x, inner.y + 2, inner.width, visible_rows);
[3028](#3028)        if is_empty(viewport) {
[3029](#3029)            return None;
[3030](#3030)        }
[3031](#3031)
[3032](#3032)        let total = self.rows.len() as u16;
[3033](#3033)        let start = self
[3034](#3034)            .scroll_offset
[3035](#3035)            .min(total.saturating_sub(visible_rows.min(total))) as usize;
[3036](#3036)        let mut rows = Vec::new();
[3037](#3037)        for row_offset in 0..visible_rows {
[3038](#3038)            let row_idx = start + row_offset as usize;
[3039](#3039)            if row_idx >= self.rows.len() {
[3040](#3040)                break;
[3041](#3041)            }
[3042](#3042)            let row_id = WidgetId::new(format!("{}:row:{row_idx}", region_id.as_ref()));
[3043](#3043)            rows.push(
[3044](#3044)                ScrollRowHit::new(row_id.clone(), row_idx)
[3045](#3045)                    .with_span_id(format!("{}:span:{row_idx}", region_id.as_ref()))
[3046](#3046)                    .with_item_id(row_id),
[3047](#3047)            );
[3048](#3048)        }
[3049](#3049)
[3050](#3050)        Some((viewport, start, rows))
[3051](#3051)    }
[3052](#3052)
[3053](#3053)    #[must_use]
[3055](#3055)    pub fn row_count(&self) -> usize {
[3056](#3056)        self.rows.len()
[3057](#3057)    }
[3058](#3058)
[3059](#3059)    fn row_label(&self, row_idx: usize) -> String {
[3060](#3060)        self.rows[row_idx]
[3061](#3061)            .iter()
[3062](#3062)            .map(Cow::as_ref)
[3063](#3063)            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
[3064](#3064)            .join(" | ")
[3065](#3065)    }
[3066](#3066)
[3067](#3067)    fn compute_widths(&self, total_width: u16) -> Vec<u16> {
[3068](#3068)        if let Some(ref w) = self.widths {
[3069](#3069)            return w.clone();
[3070](#3070)        }
[3071](#3071)        let cols = self.headers.len().max(1) as u16;
[3072](#3072)        let per_col = total_width / cols;
[3073](#3073)        let mut widths = vec![per_col; cols as usize];
[3074](#3074)        let remainder = total_width.saturating_sub(per_col * cols);
[3075](#3075)        for w in widths.iter_mut().take(remainder as usize) {
[3076](#3076)            *w += 1;
[3077](#3077)        }
[3078](#3078)        widths
[3079](#3079)    }

[3082](#3082)impl Widget for Table<'_> {
[3083](#3083)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[3084](#3084)        let inner = self
[3085](#3085)            .block
[3086](#3086)            .as_ref()
[3087](#3087)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[3088](#3088)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[3089](#3089)            block.render(buf, area);
[3090](#3090)        }
[3091](#3091)        if is_empty(inner) || self.headers.is_empty() {
[3092](#3092)            return;
[3093](#3093)        }
[3094](#3094)
[3095](#3095)        let col_widths = self.compute_widths(inner.width);
[3096](#3096)        let header_height = 1u16;
[3097](#3097)        let divider_height = 1u16;
[3098](#3098)        let data_start_y = inner.y + header_height + divider_height;
[3099](#3099)        let visible_rows = inner.height.saturating_sub(header_height + divider_height);
[3100](#3100)
[3101](#3101)        for (col_idx, header) in self.headers.iter().enumerate() {
[3102](#3102)            if col_idx >= col_widths.len() {
[3103](#3103)                break;
[3104](#3104)            }
[3105](#3105)            let col_x = inner.x + col_widths[..col_idx].iter().sum::<u16>();
[3106](#3106)            let w = col_widths[col_idx];
[3107](#3107)            paint_text(
[3108](#3108)                Rect::new(col_x, inner.y, w, 1),
[3109](#3109)                buf,
[3110](#3110)                header.as_ref(),
[3111](#3111)                Style::default()
[3112](#3112)                    .fg(self.palette.pulse)
[3113](#3113)                    .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[3114](#3114)            );
[3115](#3115)        }
[3116](#3116)
[3117](#3117)        let div_y = inner.y + header_height;
[3118](#3118)        for col_idx in 0..self.headers.len().min(col_widths.len()) {
[3119](#3119)            let col_x = inner.x + col_widths[..col_idx].iter().sum::<u16>();
[3120](#3120)            let w = col_widths[col_idx];
[3121](#3121)            for dx in 0..w {
[3122](#3122)                set_styled_char(
[3123](#3123)                    buf,
[3124](#3124)                    col_x + dx,
[3125](#3125)                    div_y,
[3126](#3126)                    '─',
[3127](#3127)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow),
[3128](#3128)                );
[3129](#3129)            }
[3130](#3130)        }
[3131](#3131)
[3132](#3132)        let total = self.rows.len() as u16;
[3133](#3133)        let start = self
[3134](#3134)            .scroll_offset
[3135](#3135)            .min(total.saturating_sub(visible_rows.min(total)));
[3136](#3136)
[3137](#3137)        for row_offset in 0..visible_rows {
[3138](#3138)            let row_idx = start as usize + row_offset as usize;
[3139](#3139)            let y = data_start_y + row_offset;
[3140](#3140)
[3141](#3141)            if row_idx >= self.rows.len() {
[3142](#3142)                break;
[3143](#3143)            }
[3144](#3144)
[3145](#3145)            let is_selected = self.selected == Some(row_idx);
[3146](#3146)            let row = &self.rows[row_idx];
[3147](#3147)
[3148](#3148)            for (col_idx, cell) in row.iter().enumerate() {
[3149](#3149)                if col_idx >= col_widths.len() {
[3150](#3150)                    break;
[3151](#3151)                }
[3152](#3152)                let col_x = inner.x + col_widths[..col_idx].iter().sum::<u16>();
[3153](#3153)                let w = col_widths[col_idx];
[3154](#3154)
[3155](#3155)                let cell_chars: Vec<char> = cell.chars().collect();
[3156](#3156)                for dx in 0..w {
[3157](#3157)                    let ch = cell_chars.get(dx as usize).copied().unwrap_or(' ');
[3158](#3158)                    let style = if is_selected {
[3159](#3159)                        Style::default()
[3160](#3160)                            .fg(self.palette.high)
[3161](#3161)                            .bg(self.palette.shadow)
[3162](#3162)                            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[3163](#3163)                    } else {
[3164](#3164)                        Style::default().fg(self.palette.high)
[3165](#3165)                    };
[3166](#3166)                    set_styled_char(buf, col_x + dx, y, ch, style);
[3167](#3167)                }
[3168](#3168)            }
[3169](#3169)        }
[3170](#3170)    }
[3171](#3171)}

[3231](#3231)        let inner = self
[3232](#3232)            .block
[3233](#3233)            .as_ref()
[3234](#3234)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[3235](#3235)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[3236](#3236)            block.render(buf, area);
[3237](#3237)        }
[3238](#3238)        if is_empty(inner) || self.data.is_empty() {
[3239](#3239)            return;

[3241](#3241)
[3242](#3242)        let max = self
[3243](#3243)            .max_value
[3244](#3244)            .unwrap_or_else(|| self.data.iter().copied().max().unwrap_or(1))
[3245](#3245)            .max(1);

[3247](#3247)

[3250](#3250)            let value = self.data.get(data_idx).copied().unwrap_or(0);
[3251](#3251)            let bar_height =
[3252](#3252)                ((f64::from(value) / f64::from(max)) * f64::from(inner.height)).round() as u16;
[3253](#3253)            let bar_y = bottom.saturating_sub(bar_height);
[3254](#3254)
[3255](#3255)            for y in bar_y..bottom {
[3256](#3256)                let noise = field_noise(inner.x + col, y, 0);
[3257](#3257)                let style = Style::default()
[3258](#3258)                    .fg(self.palette.lane(noise))
[3259](#3259)                    .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
[3260](#3260)                set_styled_char(buf, inner.x + col, y, '█', style);
[3261](#3261)            }
[3262](#3262)
[3263](#3263)            for y in inner.y..bar_y {
[3264](#3264)                set_styled_char(
[3265](#3265)                    buf,
[3266](#3266)                    inner.x + col,
[3267](#3267)                    y,
[3268](#3268)                    '·',
[3269](#3269)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow),
[3270](#3270)                );

[3413](#3413)    #[must_use]
[3415](#3415)    pub fn new(text: impl Into<Cow<'a, str>>) -> Self {
[3416](#3416)        Self {
[3417](#3417)            text: text.into(),
[3418](#3418)            scroll_offset: 0,
[3419](#3419)            palette: AislingPalette::cypherpunk(),

[3421](#3421)        }
[3422](#3422)    }
[3423](#3423)
[3424](#3424)    #[must_use]
[3426](#3426)    pub fn scroll_offset(mut self, offset: u16) -> Self {
[3427](#3427)        self.scroll_offset = offset;
[3428](#3428)        self
[3429](#3429)    }
[3430](#3430)
[3431](#3431)    #[must_use]
[3433](#3433)    pub fn palette(mut self, palette: AislingPalette) -> Self {
[3434](#3434)        self.palette = palette;
[3435](#3435)        self
[3436](#3436)    }
[3437](#3437)
[3438](#3438)    #[must_use]
[3440](#3440)    pub fn block(mut self, block: Block<'a>) -> Self {
[3441](#3441)        self.block = Some(block);
[3442](#3442)        self
[3443](#3443)    }
[3444](#3444)
[3445](#3445)    fn wrap_lines(&self, width: u16) -> Vec<Cow<'_, str>> {
[3446](#3446)        if width == 0 {
[3447](#3447)            return Vec::new();
[3448](#3448)        }
[3449](#3449)        let mut result = Vec::new();
[3450](#3450)        for raw_line in self.text.lines() {
[3451](#3451)            if raw_line.is_empty() {
[3452](#3452)                result.push(Cow::Borrowed(""));
[3453](#3453)                continue;
[3454](#3454)            }
[3455](#3455)            let mut remaining = raw_line;
[3456](#3456)            while !remaining.is_empty() {
[3457](#3457)                let w = usize::from(width);
[3458](#3458)                if remaining.len() <= w {
[3459](#3459)                    result.push(Cow::Borrowed(remaining));
[3460](#3460)                    break;
[3461](#3461)                }
[3462](#3462)                let break_at = remaining[..w].rfind(' ').map(|p| p + 1).unwrap_or(w);
[3463](#3463)                result.push(Cow::Borrowed(&remaining[..break_at]));
[3464](#3464)                remaining = &remaining[break_at..];
[3465](#3465)            }
[3466](#3466)        }
[3467](#3467)        result
[3468](#3468)    }
[3469](#3469)}
[3470](#3470)
[3471](#3471)impl Widget for Paragraph<'_> {
[3472](#3472)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[3473](#3473)        let inner = self
[3474](#3474)            .block
[3475](#3475)            .as_ref()
[3476](#3476)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[3477](#3477)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[3478](#3478)            block.render(buf, area);
[3479](#3479)        }
[3480](#3480)        if is_empty(inner) {
[3481](#3481)            return;
[3482](#3482)        }
[3483](#3483)
[3484](#3484)        let wrapped = self.wrap_lines(inner.width);
[3485](#3485)        let total = wrapped.len() as u16;
[3486](#3486)        let start = self
[3487](#3487)            .scroll_offset
[3488](#3488)            .min(total.saturating_sub(inner.height.min(total)));
[3489](#3489)
[3490](#3490)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[3491](#3491)            let line_idx = start as usize + row as usize;
[3492](#3492)            let y = inner.y + row;
[3493](#3493)
[3494](#3494)            if line_idx >= wrapped.len() {
[3495](#3495)                break;
[3496](#3496)            }
[3497](#3497)
[3498](#3498)            let line = &wrapped[line_idx];
[3499](#3499)            let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
[3500](#3500)
[3501](#3501)            for col in 0..inner.width {
[3502](#3502)                let ch = chars.get(col as usize).copied().unwrap_or(' ');
[3503](#3503)                let style = if ch == ' ' {
[3504](#3504)                    Style::default()
[3505](#3505)                } else {
[3506](#3506)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.high)
[3507](#3507)                };
[3508](#3508)                set_styled_char(buf, inner.x + col, y, ch, style);
[3509](#3509)            }
[3510](#3510)        }
[3511](#3511)    }

[3606](#3606)impl Widget for StatusBar<'_> {
[3607](#3607)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[3608](#3608)        if is_empty(area) || self.sections.is_empty() {
[3609](#3609)            return;
[3610](#3610)        }
[3611](#3611)
[3612](#3612)        let bg_style = Style::default()
[3613](#3613)            .fg(self.palette.high)
[3614](#3614)            .bg(self.palette.shadow);
[3615](#3615)
[3616](#3616)        for x in area.x..area.x.saturating_add(area.width) {
[3617](#3617)            for y in area.y..area.y.saturating_add(area.height) {
[3618](#3618)                set_styled_char(buf, x, y, ' ', bg_style);
[3619](#3619)            }
[3620](#3620)        }
[3621](#3621)
[3622](#3622)        let left_sections: Vec<_> = self
[3623](#3623)            .sections
[3624](#3624)            .iter()
[3625](#3625)            .filter(|s| s.align == Align::Left)
[3626](#3626)            .collect();
[3627](#3627)        let center_sections: Vec<_> = self
[3628](#3628)            .sections
[3629](#3629)            .iter()
[3630](#3630)            .filter(|s| s.align == Align::Center)
[3631](#3631)            .collect();
[3632](#3632)        let right_sections: Vec<_> = self
[3633](#3633)            .sections
[3634](#3634)            .iter()
[3635](#3635)            .filter(|s| s.align == Align::Right)
[3636](#3636)            .collect();
[3637](#3637)
[3638](#3638)        let mut x = area.x;
[3639](#3639)
[3640](#3640)        for section in &left_sections {
[3641](#3641)            let text: Vec<char> = section.text.chars().collect();
[3642](#3642)            let max_len = text
[3643](#3643)                .len()
[3644](#3644)                .min(usize::from(area.width.saturating_sub(x - area.x)));
[3645](#3645)            for (i, &ch) in text.iter().take(max_len).enumerate() {
[3646](#3646)                set_styled_char(
[3647](#3647)                    buf,
[3648](#3648)                    x + i as u16,
[3649](#3649)                    area.y,
[3650](#3650)                    ch,
[3651](#3651)                    Style::default()
[3652](#3652)                        .fg(self.palette.high)
[3653](#3653)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[3654](#3654)                );
[3655](#3655)            }
[3656](#3656)            x += max_len as u16;
[3657](#3657)        }
[3658](#3658)
[3659](#3659)        for section in ¢er_sections {
[3660](#3660)            let text: Vec<char> = section.text.chars().collect();
[3661](#3661)            let available = area.width.saturating_sub(x - area.x);
[3662](#3662)            let start_offset = available.saturating_sub(text.len() as u16) / 2;
[3663](#3663)            x += start_offset;
[3664](#3664)            for (i, &ch) in text.iter().take(usize::from(available)).enumerate() {
[3665](#3665)                set_styled_char(
[3666](#3666)                    buf,
[3667](#3667)                    x + i as u16,
[3668](#3668)                    area.y,
[3669](#3669)                    ch,
[3670](#3670)                    Style::default()
[3671](#3671)                        .fg(self.palette.high)
[3672](#3672)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[3673](#3673)                );
[3674](#3674)            }
[3675](#3675)            x += text.len() as u16;
[3676](#3676)        }
[3677](#3677)
[3678](#3678)        let right_x = area.x + area.width;
[3679](#3679)        let mut render_x = right_x;
[3680](#3680)        for section in right_sections.iter().rev() {
[3681](#3681)            let text: Vec<char> = section.text.chars().collect();
[3682](#3682)            render_x = render_x.saturating_sub(text.len() as u16);
[3683](#3683)            for (i, &ch) in text.iter().enumerate() {
[3684](#3684)                if render_x + (i as u16) >= area.x && render_x + (i as u16) < right_x {
[3685](#3685)                    set_styled_char(
[3686](#3686)                        buf,
[3687](#3687)                        render_x + i as u16,
[3688](#3688)                        area.y,
[3689](#3689)                        ch,
[3690](#3690)                        Style::default()
[3691](#3691)                            .fg(self.palette.high)
[3692](#3692)                            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[3693](#3693)                    );
[3694](#3694)                }
[3695](#3695)            }
[3696](#3696)        }
[3697](#3697)    }
[3698](#3698)}
[3699](#3699)
[3700](#3700)#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
[3707](#3707)pub struct Bordered<'a> {
[3708](#3708)    title: Cow<'a, str>,
[3709](#3709)    palette: AislingPalette,
[3710](#3710)}
[3711](#3711)
[3712](#3712)impl PartialEq for Bordered<'_> {
[3713](#3713)    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
[3714](#3714)        self.title == other.title && self.palette == other.palette
[3715](#3715)    }
[3716](#3716)}
[3717](#3717)
[3718](#3718)impl<'a> Bordered<'a> {
[3719](#3719)    #[must_use]
[3721](#3721)    pub fn new(title: impl Into<Cow<'a, str>>) -> Self {
[3722](#3722)        Self {
[3723](#3723)            title: title.into(),
[3724](#3724)            palette: AislingPalette::cypherpunk(),
[3725](#3725)        }
[3726](#3726)    }
[3727](#3727)
[3728](#3728)    #[must_use]
[3730](#3730)    pub fn palette(mut self, palette: AislingPalette) -> Self {
[3731](#3731)        self.palette = palette;
[3732](#3732)        self
[3733](#3733)    }
[3734](#3734)
[3735](#3735)    pub fn render_inner(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) -> Rect {
[3737](#3737)        let block = Block::new(self.title.as_ref())
[3738](#3738)            .with_borders(BorderStyle::Plain)
[3739](#3739)            .with_border_color(self.palette.mid);
[3740](#3740)        let inner = block_content_area(&block, area);
[3741](#3741)        block.render(buf, area);
[3742](#3742)        inner
[3743](#3743)    }
[3744](#3744)}
[3745](#3745)
[3746](#3746)impl Widget for Bordered<'_> {
[3747](#3747)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[3748](#3748)        self.render_inner(buf, area);
[3749](#3749)    }
[3750](#3750)}
[3751](#3751)
[3752](#3752)fn is_empty(area: Rect) -> bool {
[3757](#3757)    area.width == 0 || area.height == 0
[3758](#3758)}
[3759](#3759)
[3760](#3760)fn block_content_area(block: &Block<'_>, area: Rect) -> Rect {
[3761](#3761)    match block.borders {
[3762](#3762)        BorderStyle::None => area,
[3763](#3763)        _ => Rect::new(
[3764](#3764)            area.x.saturating_add(1),
[3765](#3765)            area.y.saturating_add(1),
[3766](#3766)            area.width.saturating_sub(2),
[3767](#3767)            area.height.saturating_sub(2),
[3768](#3768)        ),
[3769](#3769)    }
[3770](#3770)}
[3771](#3771)
[3772](#3772)fn option_block_eq(left: Option<&Block<'_>>, right: Option<&Block<'_>>) -> bool {
[3773](#3773)    match (left, right) {
[3774](#3774)        (Some(left), Some(right)) => block_eq(left, right),
[3775](#3775)        (None, None) => true,
[3776](#3776)        _ => false,
[3777](#3777)    }
[3778](#3778)}
[3779](#3779)
[3780](#3780)fn block_eq(left: &Block<'_>, right: &Block<'_>) -> bool {
[3781](#3781)    left.title == right.title
[3782](#3782)        && left.title_right == right.title_right
[3783](#3783)        && left.borders == right.borders
[3784](#3784)        && left.border_color == right.border_color
[3785](#3785)        && left.bg == right.bg
[3786](#3786)        && left.style == right.style
[3787](#3787)        && left.inner_margin == right.inner_margin
[3788](#3788)}
[3789](#3789)
[3790](#3790)fn is_edge(area: Rect, x: u16, y: u16) -> bool {
[3791](#3791)    x == area.x
[3792](#3792)        || y == area.y
[3793](#3793)        || x + 1 == area.x.saturating_add(area.width)
[3794](#3794)        || y + 1 == area.y.saturating_add(area.height)
[3795](#3795)}
[3796](#3796)
[3797](#3797)fn field_noise(x: u16, y: u16, tick: u64) -> u64 {
[3798](#3798)    let mut value = u64::from(x).wrapping_mul(0x9e37_79b9_7f4a_7c15)
[3799](#3799)        ^ u64::from(y).wrapping_mul(0xbf58_476d_1ce4_e5b9)
[3800](#3800)        ^ tick.wrapping_mul(0x94d0_49bb_1331_11eb);
[3801](#3801)    value ^= value >> 30;
[3802](#3802)    value = value.wrapping_mul(0xbf58_476d_1ce4_e5b9);
[3803](#3803)    value ^= value >> 27;
[3804](#3804)    value = value.wrapping_mul(0x94d0_49bb_1331_11eb);
[3805](#3805)    value ^ (value >> 31)
[3806](#3806)}
[3807](#3807)
[3808](#3808)fn paint_text(area: Rect, buf: &mut Buffer, text: &str, style: Style) {
[3809](#3809)    if is_empty(area) {
[3810](#3810)        return;
[3811](#3811)    }
[3812](#3812)
[3813](#3813)    let right = area.x.saturating_add(area.width);
[3814](#3814)    for (offset, glyph) in text.chars().take(usize::from(area.width)).enumerate() {
[3815](#3815)        let x = area.x + offset as u16;
[3816](#3816)        if x >= right {
[3817](#3817)            break;
[3818](#3818)        }
[3819](#3819)        set_styled_char(buf, x, area.y, glyph, style);
[3820](#3820)    }
[3821](#3821)}
[3822](#3822)
[3823](#3823)fn clipped_text(text: &str, width: u16) -> String {
[3824](#3824)    text.chars().take(usize::from(width)).collect()
[3825](#3825)}
[3826](#3826)
[3827](#3827)fn set_cell_bg(buf: &mut Buffer, x: u16, y: u16, bg: Color) {
[3828](#3828)    let Some(mut cell) = buf.get(usize::from(x), usize::from(y)).copied() else {
[3829](#3829)        return;
[3830](#3830)    };
[3831](#3831)    cell.bg = Some(bg);
[3832](#3832)    buf.set(usize::from(x), usize::from(y), cell);
[3833](#3833)}
[3834](#3834)
[3835](#3835)fn set_cell_style(buf: &mut Buffer, x: u16, y: u16, style: Style) {
[3836](#3836)    let Some(cell) = buf.get(usize::from(x), usize::from(y)).copied() else {
[3837](#3837)        return;
[3838](#3838)    };
[3839](#3839)    buf.set(usize::from(x), usize::from(y), replace_style(cell, style));
[3840](#3840)}
[3841](#3841)
[3842](#3842)fn set_styled_char(buf: &mut Buffer, x: u16, y: u16, ch: char, style: Style) {
[3843](#3843)    buf.set(
[3844](#3844)        usize::from(x),
[3845](#3845)        usize::from(y),
[3846](#3846)        replace_style(
[3847](#3847)            Cell::new(ch, style.fg.unwrap_or(Color::WHITE), style.bg),
[3848](#3848)            style,
[3849](#3849)        ),
[3850](#3850)    );
[3851](#3851)}
[3852](#3852)
[3853](#3853)fn replace_style(mut cell: Cell, style: Style) -> Cell {
[3854](#3854)    cell.fg = style.fg.unwrap_or(Color::WHITE);
[3855](#3855)    cell.bg = style.bg;
[3856](#3856)    cell.bold = (style.bold || style.add_modifier.contains(Modifier::BOLD))
[3857](#3857)        && !style.sub_modifier.contains(Modifier::BOLD);
[3858](#3858)    cell.italic = (style.italic || style.add_modifier.contains(Modifier::ITALIC))
[3859](#3859)        && !style.sub_modifier.contains(Modifier::ITALIC);
[3860](#3860)    cell.underlined = (style.underlined || style.add_modifier.contains(Modifier::UNDERLINED))
[3861](#3861)        && !style.sub_modifier.contains(Modifier::UNDERLINED);
[3862](#3862)    cell
[3863](#3863)}
